What is uncertain

Uncertainty: high

The combined strategy is a derived research hypothesis. The cited evidence does not establish that dual targeting improves outcomes in humans, and the optimal biological interaction, timing and experimental context remain unresolved.

Open questions

  • Does perturbing the CD44-associated metastatic state alter sensitivity to immune-niche intervention?
  • Is concurrent or sequential intervention more informative in appropriate osteosarcoma models?
  • Which bone or pulmonary niche mechanism is the most causally relevant partner for testing?
  • Does the combined effect reproduce across independent models?
